note: B is the cleaner set: it avoids A's five invented "location = wall" attributions for the tags EX, CT, GT, WO and RF, A's misreading of the graphic scale bar (0 1' 2' 4') as "scale = 4 ft", and A's duplicated claims (robe hook height stated twice, 10' - 3 15/16" stated as both "total width" and "dimension", MWK03 stated as both component label and panel identifier). Both sets, however, make the same serious misbinding: 8' - 9 7/16" is the overall height of the D5 North Kitchen Elevation, not the H1 robe hook mounting height, which the bathroom elevation gives as 4' - 0"; both also hang 8' - 6 13/16" and 7' - 6" on finish code P3 and put 2' - 8 9/16" (a top dimension of the A6 West Bathroom Elevation) under North Kitchen Elevation. B adds one claim of its own that is wrong (MWK03 called a wall/surface material/finish), but overall it loses fewer claims to misbinding and invention.
remarks: Both shown sets fabricate the quote 'H1 ROBE HOOK MOUNTING HEIGHT 8' - 9 7/16"' by joining a label in the bathroom elevation to a dimension from the D5 kitchen elevation; the sheet's actual H1 mounting height is 4' - 0". Both also miss other visible facts (BULKHEAD FIN. W/ P3, DIRTT BREATHE LIVING WALL 4'-0" W x 5'-6", SEE ARTWORK PKG FOR SIZE & MOUNT LOCATIONS, 17' - 3 1/8" West Kitchen total width), though some may sit in the unshown shared claims. The bathroom elevation at top left is cut off in the text layer ('ATHROOM ELEVATION'), so its detail number could not be read. Repeated values (2' - 6 3/8" x3-4, 10' - 3 15/16" x2) are handled inconsistently: A splits them into 'first/second instance' and duplicates, B into 'segment width 1/2/3'; neither ties them to a named elevation or segment.
